# BuildNest

> Home construction management app for Indian homeowners.

BuildNest is a free web application that helps Indian homeowners plan, track, and manage their home construction projects. It replaces spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups with a single organised workspace.

## What it does

- Budget tracking — set a total budget, log every expense, and see spend by category
- Task management — create and track construction tasks with priority and due dates
- Milestone tracking — define phases (foundation, structure, finishing) and mark them complete
- Contractor management — directory of all contractors with contact details and trade
- Materials tracking — track orders, deliveries, and installation status
- Document storage — upload permits, contracts, and invoices
- Photo log — site progress photos grouped by month
- Analytics — spend trends, category breakdown, contractor costs

## Who it is for

Indian homeowners who are building or renovating a residential property and want one place to track everything instead of managing it across Excel, WhatsApp, and paper.

## Live app

https://buildnest-saas.vercel.app
